title: Learn4Good Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape jobs from Learn4Good using keyword/location search or a direct search URL.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Direct Learn4Good search URL. If provided, it overrides keyword and location.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search term(s) for jobs when Start URL is not provided.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location filter when Start URL is not provided.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Uses Apify datacenter proxies by default.
